Fig. 1: Overview of C2RM-Seg. (a) Pseudo-Mask Generation: The C2RM rectifies CAMs by performing counterfactual intervention Zcf = Z −E on latent factors Z using a learnable causal matrix A. (b) Segmentation Training: A Dual-Path Structural-Semantic Architecture synergizes ResNeSt [23] features with frozen DINOV3 [24] priors via cross-path gating. The model is optimized using a UGM loss that dynamically re-weights supervision based on prediction uncertainty to mitigate label noise.
